memory_update.text: CAMT should be tracked as an underfollowed inspection/metrology supplier tied to advanced packaging, HBM, hybrid bonding, and high-density micro-bump yield control. Key survival test: multi-customer 2026 order durability and HBM/advanced-packaging revenue visibility.

FORM should be tracked as an underfollowed HBM known-good-die and wafer-probe-card node. Key survival test: sustained HBM probe-card revenue, backlog, pricing, and margin expansion rather than one-time qualification demand.

ONTO should be tracked as an underfollowed process-control, inspection/metrology, and advanced-packaging lithography supplier. Key survival test: broadening HBM/advanced-packaging customer adoption beyond a few volume purchase agreements.
AMKR should remain a reference/control OSAT capacity name for advanced packaging and package/test capacity rather than the primary underfollowed alpha target in this chunk.

KLIC is a second-order bonding/interconnect equipment hypothesis. It should not be upgraded without evidence of production orders in TCB, hybrid bonding, advanced memory, CPO, or heterogeneous integration.
AIXA.DE is a CPO/silicon-photonics upstream MOCVD/compound-epitaxy hypothesis. It requires evidence that datacom/photonics/CPO orders are material relative to power electronics or LED cycles.
OXIG.L is a niche III-V etch/deposition and photonics-tools hypothesis. Segment evidence must show semiconductor photonics order acceleration before it can survive later scoring.

HUBN.SW is an optical-connectivity/data-center-interconnect hypothesis. The AI relationship is plausible but currently weak until AI data-center, CPO, or high-density optical connectivity is visible in segment growth or backlog.
COHU is a backend test-handler/contactor/thermal-test hypothesis. It requires proof that AI/HBM/GPU-related demand is material enough to offset weaker legacy semiconductor end markets.

6239.TW should be tracked as an underfollowed memory-backend OSAT/FOPLP hypothesis. Current evidence is mostly external search context, so company filings, monthly revenue, margins, customer validation, and capex evidence are required before upgrade.

Primary-source validation is missing for most company-specific claims in this chunk. Later layers should prioritize annual reports, exchange filings, earnings-call transcripts, investor decks, order/backlog disclosures, customer announcements, and segment revenue bridges.
